items.item: (1) Entries whose says, part or reading quote or restate a sentence the changed files no longer hold
items.how: Three checks, run before and after. (a) A quote check: every fragment in straight or curly single quotes, double quotes, “” or 「」 (split at ellipses; three words or four CJK characters at least) in a target anchored at, or recording, any of the 365 files changed since 22f65660c (the sixth and seventh passes and main's merge), against the current page or record with links, emphasis and HTML tags stripped, and the same check at 22f65660c; fragments in readings and adds against all of the entry's homes. Before: 58 fragments in 37 entries held at 22f65660c and failed now. After: none. (b) A clause scan: every clause of five words or more in such a target held by the old home and not the new. Before: 259 clauses in 125 entries; after: none. (c) The lists in the sixth and seventh passes' reports (ch07, ch08, onepage, records, dossiers, rest, screen and their verifiers), every named entry read. Re-said from the homes as they stand: 07 §4's lead, table and paragraph ('Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it'; 'C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens'), the self-concern theorem's paragraph ('ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern: where the condition holds, that concern already does it'; 'that a life forms such an order is not shown'), §4.4's theorem and Sen paragraph, T5 ('That actual valuers count every item above zero is what the thesis takes, not shown'), T8 (40 entries), the does-not-show list and the warrant item; 08's 'Where the ethics sits', the philosophical-questions bullet and the Parfit cell ('an order meeting C ranks a course with a costless addition'); the one page's ethics, case ('preserving the fishers' own continuation does not require preserving the bed'), Join row (C glossed as `Comparison`), 'belong to one loop' (6 entries) and not-yet-done list; 05's Bases, D65 label, the organizational Conditional and its not-shown sentence; 06's 道, 德, 机制 and 易传 sentences (广者居上, 以广为愈 gone from the crosswalk); 04's D65 ('its evaluation as right or wrong'); 02's not-shown on generation; 08's edge sentence ('None is a premise: the condition and C, hypotheses where used, are listed apart'); and the changed records (what-self-concern-alone-ranks, weights-within-a-ratio-agree-past-it, a-narrowing-above-its-widening, widening-as-what-every-positive-weighting-ranks, comparison-by-widening, shaping-the-rule-selected-by-what-comes-back, shaping-selected-among-groups, selection-with-returns-to-groupmates, when-no-route-stands-above-a-revision, confined-rise-within-a-whole, the-continuation-condition-on-the-root, self-concern-through-dependence, where-the-possible-grows).

items.item: (2) Entries' own wording in the rejected frame or saying more than H1–H10 allow
items.how: Searched every reading, add, says and part for 'for scope', 'for order', 'C for order', '(scope)', '(order)', 'read under scope and order', 'C's', 'C gives', 'C ranks' (unqualified), 'C orders', 'C leaves', 'named order', 'C or another', 'C is a named order', 'C, an order', 'an order some formations hold', 'every positive weighting', 'does not reach those who depend', 'continues with', 'not yet joined', 'one theorem', 'second premise', 'premise relocated', 'placed at the standpoint', 'listed level paths', 'listed courses', 'courses that end', 'argued' beside the order's formation, 'a life that goes on holds', 'a matter of reach', 'warrant to find', 'warrant binding', 'not as a warrant', 'Answered within the map', 'seeing is not valuing', 'fixes scope' and 以广为愈, and read each hit. Re-said: C as the requirement on an order ('an order meeting C', 'C asks', 'C names the requirement ...'), never as an order (H5); 'C or another named order' as 'an order a result names, one meeting C or another'; 'ranking the wider above is C's' as 'an order's: self-concern's on a finite listing where the condition holds de se, or one a result names'; 'the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order' as 07 §7's label 'the continuation condition, C read as widening, J1–J4, correspondence E'; 'C leaves/decides mixed' as 'widening leaves ... unranked' or 'C asks nothing of mixed comparisons'; 'every positive weighting ranks it higher' as 'every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero ranks it higher' on a finite listing (H1); 'concern along dependence does not reach' as 'concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one' (H4); 'self-concern's monotonicity' as 'self-concern is increasing in admission and ranks every widening above, as C asks on that listing'; the warrant frame as 'seeks no authority outside becoming (argued)' with 'whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind, the work does not claim or settle' (F5); 'as seeing, not as a warrant' as T8's 'a way of seeing, not a verdict'; 'seeing is not valuing' as 'seeing is needed, and not enough'. Kept where the word is a source's or another sense (a source's warrant, 'a class is warranted', 'warranted limits', 05's 'can warrant building shared capacity', 07 §5's 'loss of warrant'), where 'C ranks' is 07's 'every comparison satisfying C ranks', and where an AI reading says a ranking is held 'under a scope and order they name', which 07 §4's own use of scope and order still fits. Three group summaries carried the frame (keep-the-possibility-space-open, zhishan-intelligence-must-be-good, systems-cybernetics) and were re-said the same way.

items.item: (3) The six entries citing the withdrawn record universal-practical-warrant
items.how: cx-kpso-fidelity-to-the-process (targets[1]), cx-zhishan-logic-cannot-compel (targets[1]), cx-zhishan-must-be-good (targets[2]), cx-greek-protagoras-measure (targets[1]), cx-greek-cicero-natural-law (targets[0]) and cx-greek-sextus-suspension (targets[0]): the 'record' key dropped, the anchor 07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#r-universal-practical-warrant kept, as other anchor-only targets are. Their says now quote 07's item: 'Set aside as a question the map does not need: the ethics seeks no authority outside becoming and offers itself without one, argued on the thesis of one relational unfolding'; what is proved (with significance free the represented dynamics do not force the condition; a perspectivist denies it without contradiction, bounded_rival); and 'Whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind, the work does not claim or settle.' The same re-saying in cx-abr-divine-command (anchor-only already) and in those entries' readings and adds (Cicero, Sextus, Protagoras, zhishan, Jonas, stewardship, Parfit, divine command). atlas.validate: 0 errors (6 before).

Every target anchored at the page was checked by (1)'s quote and clause checks. Re-said from the page as the rest agent left it: 'seeing is needed, and not enough, since reading a loss, counting it and ranking courses are separate relations, and coupling is not compliance' (10 entries); 'ranking the widening course above is an order's, self-concern's on a finite listing where the condition holds de se or one a result names' (8); 'every additive weighting giving each listed item a weight above zero weighs it higher' (7); 'The direction is a criterion on which every such weighting agrees' with the weighting said; 'Whose losses count:' for 'Scope:'; the answer in brief and the opening's generative direction (cx-wamo-coordination-bottleneck, cx-ecs-surpass-as-goal, cx-ma-plural-ends); 'a hypothesis, asking less of an order than C does' for 'a premise weaker than C'.

H1 additive on a finite listing wherever widening is said as what weightings rank; the record's defined term 'positive weighting' kept where a target restates weights-within-a-ratio. H2 'ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern', 'no second premise' gone. H3 'not shown: in the proofs it is a hypothesis', with 07 §4.9's filter where an entry says how a life comes to the order; no 'argued' for it remains. H4 'need not count'. H5 C a requirement; 广者居上 in the 06 quotes. H6 no acyclic or one-center gloss remains in the file; 'read across all steps' where relations close. H7 'nothing lies outside each one's reach along that relation', 'continues with' gone. H8 'level paths whose admissions end' / 'admitted (step, formation) pairs fit in a finite list'. H9 'the two results compose directly, though no single theorem states the composite'. H10 entries quoting the fronts keep 'The ethics emerges from continuation' and say what is shown, offered and open, as 08's '"Emerges" names neither a derivation nor a shown development' does.

for_ren: The standard re-sayings, each from its current home: 'Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it' (replacing 'Neither stands above becoming: each is an order or scope some formations hold', 27 entries); 'C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens ... it asks nothing of mixed comparisons' (replacing 'C, widening, ranks a course above every course it widens'); 'where the condition holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths whose admissions end; elsewhere a result names the order its theorem takes' (replacing 'holding one's own continuation ranks as C does between listed level paths; beyond that C is a named order'); 'Ranking the wider above is an order's: self-concern's on a finite listing where the condition holds de se, or one a result names' (replacing 'is C's').

T8 in 40 entries now ends: 'where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance' (07's 'we', as T8 says it), in place of 'concern along dependence does not reach ... as seeing, not as a warrant'.

Where a source claims a warrant or a should binding every mind (Cicero, Sextus, Protagoras, divine command, stewardship, Jonas, Parfit, zhishan), the account's side now says it 'seeks no authority outside becoming (argued)' and that whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind it 'does not claim or settle', in place of 'there is no warrant binding every mind to find'. This says less than before, as 07's item now does.

Two AI readings say a little differently than before, worth your eye: cx-kpso-one-chosen-premise reads the folder's 'one chosen premise' as become 'the hypotheses each ranking result states, the continuation condition, self-concern or C, with the ethics emerging from continuation and, where the condition holds, ranking by widening adding no premise beside a life's own concern'; cx-greek-sextus-suspension's answer to 'why act under a hypothesis' now says that going on is not yet an order and that a life's forming one is not shown (07 §4), where it said 'a life that goes on holds its own continuation, argued'.
